title: 第六章 壁垒初成
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

9月14日，星期天。

距离病毒爆发，不到三十六个小时。

清晨六点，林越站在冷库二楼的临时住处里，对着墙上手绘的园区平面图做最后的施工推演。这张图是老郑昨晚画完的，用从便利店买的白板笔直接画在冷库的白墙上，笔触粗粝但比例精准。每一栋建筑、每一段围墙、每一个出入口都用不同颜色的标记区分——红色是需要优先加固的薄弱点，黄色是次要工事，蓝色是预留的扩展区域。

林越在红色标记最密集的东侧围墙上画了一个圈。

“从这里开始。”他转过身，对着站在身后的六个人说。

赵铭、大刘、老郑、小何、阿青，再加上昨晚正式入伙的陆寒霜。七个人挤在这间不到二十平米的房间里，有人端着搪瓷杯喝水，有人靠在墙上吃压缩饼干，但他们看着林越的眼神是一致的——专注，没有多余的废话。经过昨天一整天的物资采购和基地布置，这支临时拼凑的队伍已经开始形成默契。

“东侧围墙有三处薄弱点。第一处是后门那个缺口，一米宽，得用水泥封死。第二处是东南角的墙体裂缝，老郑昨天敲过，声音发空，内部可能有结构损伤，需要从外侧加装钢板加固。第三处是整个围墙顶端没有防攀爬设施。我今天上午带大刘把昨天买的铁丝网全部装上去，沿围墙顶端拉一圈，与墙面形成七十度外倾角。普通丧尸爬不上来，舔食者攀墙的时候也会被铁丝挂住，给我们争取五到十秒的反应时间。”

陆寒霜抱着手臂靠在墙角，从林越开始说话就一言不发。直到他说完铁丝网的角度和战术作用，她才开口。

“七十度外倾角是对的。但铁丝网底部要埋进墙顶以下至少二十公分，不能直接用铁丝绑在墙头——丧尸的重量扯不住，一拽就掉。”她的声音不高，但每个字都像是在部署作战任务，“铁丝网的顶端要留毛刺，剪断的时候不要剪平，用钳子往外掰弯。毛刺能刮下丧尸的肉，挂得越多，网越不容易被冲垮。”

林越看了她一眼，点了一下头。这就是他需要陆寒霜的原因。铁丝网的安装方式对他来说只是“防攀爬”，对她来说却是精确到毛刺角度和受力点的战术工程。

“你指挥铁丝网安装。”林越说，“大刘给你打下手。”

陆寒霜没有推辞，也没有表现出被重用的得意。她只是点了一下头，然后走到墙边，用指甲在平面图上的围墙线轻轻划了一圈：“一圈下来总长大概一千米。你昨天买的铁丝网是四卷，每卷二十五米，加起来一百米。只够覆盖十分之一的围墙。”

“先把正门两侧和东墙覆盖了。”林越说，“剩下的等今天下午补充物资的时候再买。小何，你查一下城北还有哪些地方能买到镀锌铁丝网——除了仓储超市之外。”

小何已经在敲电脑了。“查到了。城北建材市场有三家五金店，库存显示加起来还有十二卷。但今天是周日，不一定全开门。”

“能开几家买几家。”林越拿起放在桌上的工兵铲，铲刃昨天赵铭磨过，在晨光里泛着冷冽的钢色，“所有人，上午七点开始施工。中午十二点之前，东侧围墙的缺口必须封死，铁丝网必须装完。下午分组行动——赵铭跟我去建材市场补物资。老郑带小何继续囤汽油，油桶昨天还剩五个空的，今天全部灌满。阿青留守，把昨天没买完的慢性病药清单再核对一遍，中午之前给我最终版。”

“我呢？”

问这话的人是王浩。

他从门口挤进来，身上穿着一件满是油污的灰色工装，手里拿着一块拆下来的柴油机喷油嘴。他是今天早上五点半到的，比所有人都早，一到就钻进了配电房。林越注意到他的眼睛里有血丝——昨晚显然没睡，在赶工检测那台老柴油发电机。

“电机怎么样？”林越问。

“缸体内部没有裂纹，活塞环有点锈但不严重，能修。”王浩把喷油嘴举起来，上面沾着黑色的积碳，“喷油嘴堵了三个，得换。机油滤清器彻底报废。其他零件拆开看了，曲轴和连杆都没问题。你给我配件，我今天晚上就能让它转起来。”

“配件清单给我。”

王浩从口袋里掏出一张皱巴巴的纸，展开递给林越。上面密密麻麻写着七八行字，字迹歪歪扭扭，但每一项后面都标注了型号和可能的替代型号——他的专业习惯，永远给备用方案。

林越扫了一眼清单，递给小何。“查一下这些配件哪里能买到。”

“柴油机配件……”小何放大屏幕上的城北地图，切换到工业品市场图层，“城北汽配城，有三家柴油机配件店。但今天是周日，汽配城大部分店关门，开门的可能只有一两家。不一定有他需要的全部型号。”

“能买到多少买多少。买不到的——”林越转向王浩，“你刚才说可以用替代型号？”

“看情况。喷油嘴好办，只要喷油量差不多就能调。滤清器麻烦点，如果接口不一样，需要自己做转接法兰。给我一块钢板，我能用角磨机切出来。”

“钢板我们有。赵铭，昨天建材区拿回来的那批加固件里有几块钢板？”

“四块，三毫米厚的。”赵铭立刻回答，“本来是配电房加固用的。”

“够不够？”

“够。”王浩说，“三毫米够了，打孔我用台钻——你们这儿有台钻吗？”

“没有。”林越说，“今天下午去买。”

王浩点了一下头，把喷油嘴塞回口袋里，转身准备回配电房继续干活。走到门口又停下来，回过头，用一种大概他自己都没意识到的认真语气说：“林哥——这台柴油机如果修好，能带得动整个园区的照明和基础用电。到时候就不是三台小发电机撑着了。这台机子功率七十千瓦，够你用的。”

林越看着他。胖子的眼睛里那些血丝在晨光里显得格外明显，但他的眼神是亮的，那种被人需要、被人当回事的光芒，从昨晚到现在没有暗下去过。

“我知道。”林越说，“去修。配件下午给你带回来。”

王浩转身走了。

七点整，施工开始。

北郊清晨的空气带着秋天特有的干燥凉意。林越脱掉外套，穿着一件短袖T恤，和大刘一起把昨天买的水泥袋搬到后门缺口处。水泥是高标号的，凝固速度快，适合紧急修补。老郑已经从附近废弃工地上捡回来一堆碎砖块，堆在缺口旁边。

“先把缺口两侧松动的砖头敲掉。”林越蹲下来，用手摸了一圈缺口的边缘，“这里——去年下过几场大雨，砂浆被冲走了一半。如果不把松动的清掉，新砌的砖吃不住力，丧尸一推就倒。”

大刘抡起大锤，对准林越指的位置一锤下去。松动的砖块应声碎裂，碎片溅到林越裤腿上，他没有躲。老郑蹲在另一边，用凿子清理缝隙里的碎砂浆。两个人各干一头，动作都不花哨，但每一下都到位。前世在末世里，砌墙是每个幸存者必学的基础技能——不会砌墙的人都死了。

“林哥。”大刘一边敲砖一边问，“你说丧尸推墙——它们力气有多大？”

“普通丧尸跟人差不多，单个推不倒砖墙。但丧尸不会单独行动。最小的尸群也有三十只以上，后面推前面的，前面的撞墙，力量叠加——两米五的砖墙，如果没有加固，一个三十只的尸群能在十分钟之内撞开。”

“那五十公分混凝土呢？”

“普通丧尸撞一辈子也撞不开。但如果是巨力丧尸——那种变异体的力量相当于一辆四十公里时速的轿车——混凝土墙也扛不住连续的正面撞击。所以我们需要多重防线。铁丝网是第一道，墙是第二道，墙后面的陷坑是第三道。陷坑我们今天挖不了，得等末世之后，用工兵铲和人力挖。先挖正门外面。”

大刘没有说话，抡锤的力气明显又加了一分。

Sunday, September 14th.

It was less than thirty-six hours before the virus broke out.

At six o'clock in the morning, Lin Yue stood in his temporary residence on the second floor of the cold storage, making final construction deductions against the hand-painted park floor plan on the wall.Lao Zheng finished drawing this picture last night. He used a whiteboard pen bought from a convenience store to draw it directly on the white wall of the cold storage. The strokes were rough but the proportions were precise.Each building, each section of wall, and each entrance and exit are marked with different colors - red is the weak point that needs to be reinforced first, yellow is the secondary fortification, and blue is the reserved expansion area.

Lin Yue drew a circle on the east wall where the red marks were the densest.

"Start from here." He turned around and said to the six people standing behind him.

Zhao Ming, Da Liu, Lao Zheng, Xiao He, Ah Qing, plus Lu Hanshuang who officially joined the team last night.Seven people were crowded into this room of less than 20 square meters. Some were drinking from enamel cups, while others were leaning against the wall and eating compressed biscuits. However, the eyes they looked at Lin Yue were the same - focused and without unnecessary nonsense.After a whole day of material procurement and base layout yesterday, this improvised team has begun to form a tacit understanding.

"There are three weak points in the east wall. The first point is the gap at the back door, which is one meter wide and needs to be sealed with cement. The second point is the crack in the wall in the southeast corner. Lao Zheng knocked on it yesterday and the sound was hollow. There may be structural damage inside and steel plates need to be reinforced from the outside. The third point is the top of the entire fence.There are no anti-climbing facilities.This morning I took Da Liu to install all the barbed wire that I bought yesterday, and stretched it around the top of the wall to form a 70-degree angle with the wall.Ordinary zombies will not be able to climb up, and the lickers will be caught by the wire when they climb the wall, giving us five to ten seconds to react."

Lu Hanshuang leaned against the corner with his arms folded and remained silent since Lin Yue started speaking.She didn't speak until he finished talking about the angles and tactical uses of the barbed wire.

"The camber angle of seventy degrees is correct. But the bottom of the barbed wire must be buried at least 20 centimeters below the top of the wall. You cannot tie it directly to the top of the wall - the weight of the zombies cannot hold it, and it will fall off if you pull it." Her voice was not high, but every timeEvery word is like deploying a combat mission, "There should be burrs on the top of the barbed wire. When cutting, don't cut it flat. Use pliers to bend it outward. The burrs can scrape off the flesh of zombies. The more burrs are hung, the less likely the net will be washed down."

Lin Yue glanced at her and nodded.This is why he needs Lu Hanshuang.To him, the installation method of the barbed wire fence was just "anti-climbing", but to her, it was a tactical engineering that was accurate to the burr angles and stress points.

"You direct the installation of the barbed wire fence." Lin Yue said, "Da Liu will help you."

Lu Hanshuang did not refuse, nor did he show any pride in being reused.She just nodded, then walked to the wall and lightly drew a circle on the wall line on the plan with her fingernails: "The total length of the circle is about one thousand meters. The barbed wire you bought yesterday is four rolls, each roll is 25 meters, adding up to 100 meters. It is only enough to cover one-tenth of the wall."

"First cover both sides of the main entrance and the east wall." Lin Yue said, "We will buy the rest when we replenish supplies this afternoon. Xiao He, please check where else you can buy galvanized wire mesh in the north of the city - besides the warehouse supermarket."

Xiao He is already typing on the computer."I found it. There are three hardware stores in the building materials market in the north of the city, and the inventory shows that there are still twelve volumes in total. But today is Sunday, so not all of them are necessarily open."

"Buy as many as you can." Lin Yue picked up the engineering shovel placed on the table. The blade of the shovel was sharpened by Zhao Ming yesterday and glowed with a cold steel color in the morning light. "Everyone, construction will start at seven o'clock in the morning. Before twelve o'clock at noon, the gap in the east wall must be sealed and the barbed wire must be installed..In the afternoon, Zhao Ming and I went to the building materials market to replenish supplies.Lao Zheng took Xiao He to continue to stock up on gasoline. There were still five empty barrels yesterday, and they were all filled today.Ah Qing stayed behind to check the list of chronic disease medicines that he had not bought yesterday and give me the final version before noon."

"What about me?"

The person who asked this question was Wang Hao.

He squeezed in from the door, wearing a greasy gray overalls and holding a dismantled diesel injector in his hand.He arrived at 5:30 this morning, earlier than everyone else, and got into the power distribution room as soon as he arrived.Lin Yue noticed that there were bloodshot eyes in his eyes - he obviously didn't sleep last night and was rushing to inspect the old diesel generator.

"How is the motor?" Lin Yue asked.

"There are no cracks inside the cylinder. The piston ring is a little rusty but not serious and can be repaired." Wang Hao lifted the fuel injector, which was stained with black carbon deposits. "Three of the fuel injectors are clogged and need to be replaced. The oil filter is completely scrapped. I took apart the other parts and found that the crankshaft and connecting rod are fine. Give me the parts and I can make it run tonight."

"Give me the accessories list."

Wang Hao took out a crumpled piece of paper from his pocket, unfolded it and handed it to Lin Yue.There are seven or eight lines of densely written words on it, and the handwriting is crooked, but each item is marked with the model number and possible alternative models - his professional habit of always providing a backup plan.

Lin Yue glanced at the list and handed it to Xiao He.“Check where to buy these accessories.”

"Diesel engine parts..." Xiao He enlarged the map of the north city on the screen and switched to the industrial products market layer. "There are three diesel engine parts stores in the auto parts city in the north of the city. But today is Sunday, most of the stores in the auto parts city are closed, and only one or two may be open. They may not have all the models he needs."

"Buy as much as you can. What you can't buy -" Lin Yue turned to Wang Hao, "You just said you can use alternative models?"

"It depends on the situation. The fuel injector is easy to handle and can be adjusted as long as the amount of fuel injection is about the same. The filter is more troublesome. If the interface is different, you need to make an adapter flange yourself. Give me a steel plate and I can cut it out with an angle grinder."

"We have steel plates. Zhao Ming, how many steel plates were in the batch of reinforcements brought back from the building materials area yesterday?"

"Four pieces, three millimeters thick." Zhao Ming replied immediately, "It was originally used to reinforce the power distribution room."

"Is it enough?"

"Enough." Wang Hao said, "Three millimeters is enough. I will use a bench drill to drill the holes - do you have a bench drill here?"

"No." Lin Yue said, "I'll buy it this afternoon."

Wang Hao nodded, put the fuel injector back into his pocket, turned around and prepared to return to the power distribution room to continue working.He stopped again when he reached the door, turned around, and said in a serious tone that he probably didn't even realize: "Brother Lin - if this diesel engine is repaired, it can provide lighting and basic electricity for the entire park. Then it won't be supported by three small generators. The power of this machine is 70 kilowatts, which is enough for you."

Lin Yue looked at him.The bloodshot eyes in the fat man's eyes were particularly obvious in the morning light, but his eyes were bright, and the light that meant he was needed and taken seriously had not dimmed since last night.

"I know." Lin Yue said, "Go and repair it. The accessories will be brought back to you in the afternoon."

Wang Hao turned around and left.

At seven o'clock sharp, construction begins.

The early morning air in the northern suburbs has the unique dryness and coolness of autumn.Lin Yue took off his coat and wore a short-sleeved T-shirt. Together with Da Liu, he moved the cement bag he bought yesterday to the gap in the back door.Cement is of high grade and sets quickly, making it suitable for emergency repairs.Lao Zheng had already picked up a pile of broken bricks from a nearby abandoned construction site and piled them next to the gap.

"First knock off the loose bricks on both sides of the gap." Lin Yue squatted down and touched the edge of the gap with his hands. "Here - there were several heavy rains last year, and half of the mortar was washed away. If the loose bricks are not removed, the new bricks will not be able to bear the strength, and the zombies will fall down when pushed."

Da Liu picked up the sledgehammer and hit the spot pointed by Lin Yue.The loose bricks shattered and the fragments splashed onto Lin Yue's trouser legs, but he did not hide.Lao Zheng squatted on the other side and used a chisel to clean out the broken mortar in the gaps.The two of them were doing each one, and the movements were not fancy, but every move was in place.In the previous life, in the apocalypse, building walls was a basic skill that every survivor must learn - everyone who couldn't build walls died.

"Brother Lin." Da Liu asked while knocking bricks, "You said the zombies pushed the wall - how strong are they?"

"Ordinary zombies are about the same as humans. A single zombie cannot knock down a brick wall. But zombies will not move alone. The smallest group of zombies has more than thirty. The ones in the back push the ones in front, and the ones in front hit the wall. The force is superimposed - a two-meter-five-meter brick wall. If it is not reinforced, a group of thirty zombies can break through it in ten minutes."

“What about fifty centimeters of concrete?”

"Ordinary zombies won't be able to knock them away for a lifetime. But if it's a giant zombie - the strength of that mutant is equivalent to a car traveling at 40 kilometers per hour - the concrete wall can't withstand continuous frontal collisions. So we need multiple lines of defense. The barbed wire is the first line, the wall is the second line, and the pit behind the wall is the third line. We can't dig the pit today. We have to wait until the end of the world to use engineer shovels and manpower to dig it. Dig outside the main entrance first."

Da Liu didn't say anything, and his strength with the hammer obviously increased.
